chunks: Al-Ḥusayn ibn Muḥammad, from Muʿallā ibn Muḥammad, from Al-Washshāʾ, from Abān ibn ʿUthmān, from Abū Al-Ṣabbāḥ Al-Kinānī, who said:
Abū Jaʿfar (عليه السلام) looked at Abū ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ (عليه السلام) walking, and he said:
Do you see this one? This one is from those about whom Allah, Mighty and Majestic, said:
And We desired to bestow a favor upon those who were deemed weak in the land, and to make them Imams, and to make them the heirs.

key_terms.أَبُو جَعْفَرٍ: Imam Muḥammad al-Bāqir (عليه السلام), the speaker in the narration
key_terms.أَبِي عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام), referred to in the narration
key_terms.اسْتُضْعِفُوا: those who were considered weak or oppressed in the land
key_terms.الْوَارِثِينَ: those who inherit authority and divine favor

ai.seo_question: How does this hadith relate Qur'an 28:5 to the Imamate of Imam Jaʿfar al-Ṣādiq (عليه السلام)?
ai.summary: This hadith identifies Abū ʿAbdِ اللَّهِ Jaʿfar ibn Muḥammad (عليه السلام) as among those included in the divine promise mentioned in the Qur'an. It connects the verse about the oppressed being made leaders and inheritors to the rank of the Ahl al-Bayt (عليهم السلام) and their Imamate.
